query: Why did Harbor choose invite codes over open signup

results.title: Harbor signup: invite codes over open registration
results.decision: Harbor uses invite-only signup with single-use invite codes to control early access volume and support load.
results.rejected: Open signup with Stripe Checkout self-serve billing was rejected for launch due to fraud risk and incomplete billing ops.
results.constraint: Must ship within Q1 with fewer than two support engineers.
results.excerpt: Harbor uses invite-only signup with single-use invite codes to control early access volume
